note: Reference delivery profiles for common voice targets. Loudness values follow widely used practice (EBU R128 / ATSC A/85 for broadcast, ACX-style RMS window for audiobooks, -16 LUFS for stereo podcasts). Always confirm the binding specification with your delivery partner, platform or client contract before final delivery; these profiles are sensible defaults, not legal or contractual guarantees.

profiles.name: Broadcast program (EBU R128 style)
profiles.notes: EBU R128 target is -23 LUFS integrated, max true peak -1 dBTP. Verify against the actual broadcaster's technical delivery requirements.

profiles.name: Broadcast program (ATSC A/85 style)
profiles.notes: ATSC A/85 target is -24 LKFS integrated, max true peak -2 dBTP.

profiles.name: Podcast (stereo)
profiles.notes: -16 LUFS integrated stereo is the common podcast delivery target on major platforms.

profiles.name: Audiobook (ACX-style window)
profiles.notes: ACX-style technical window: RMS between -23 dB and -18 dB, peak no higher than -3 dB, mono. Confirm current ACX requirements before publishing.

profiles.name: IVR / telephony prompt
profiles.notes: Narrowband 8 kHz mono prompts for telephony; keep speech clear, avoid wideband music content. Loudness target varies by PBX/IVR vendor.

profiles.name: Web / in-app TTS streaming
profiles.notes: Common neural-TTS synthesis rate; keep integrated loudness near -20 LUFS and peaks below -1 dBFS.

profiles.name: Smart speaker / voice assistant
profiles.notes: 16 kHz mono is typical for far-field assistant playback and speech pipelines.

profiles.name: Accessibility / screen-reader narration
profiles.notes: Prioritise intelligibility: moderate pace, clear articulation, no heavy compression or background beds.

profiles.name: Clinical / speech-analysis capture
profiles.notes: Capture headroom above -6 dBFS; never gate, compress or normalise away diagnostic signal content. Confirm the clinical protocol.

profiles.name: Voicemail / hold message
profiles.notes: 8 kHz mono, conservative peaks, short and intelligible.
